claims.statement: Meta documents an App Access Token that lets an app read and modify app settings and is generated server-to-server from the app ID and app secret.

sources.supports: App access tokens let you read and modify app settings. Generate one using your Meta app secret via a server-to-server call.
sources.locator: Access Tokens for Meta Technologies, App Access Tokens

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Only existence is established. The access-tokens page states that token length changes over time and gives no format grammar; it is not recorded here.

The same page documents passing the app ID and app secret joined by a pipe as the access_token parameter instead of a generated token. Whether that composite is one more form of this family, a form of meta:app-secret, or neither is not settled; no format claim is made.
